label: 请求倍率
help: 游戏内仍需开启DLSS帧生成。5X/6X为实验功能，会增加显存占用。
source_help: fixed (the multiplier below), dynamic (DLSS-G picks the multiplier to reach the target FPS) or game (the game or NVIDIA Profile Inspector decides).

label: 动态目标帧率
help: 0跟随显示器刷新率，仅动态模式使用。
source_help: Dynamic mode target FPS. 0 follows the refresh rate of the monitor showing the game.

label: 动态允许5X/6X
help: 关闭时动态倍率最多4X；开启会增加显存需求。
source_help: Let Dynamic mode go up to 5x and 6x (needs plenty of VRAM). Off: Dynamic stays at 4x or less.

label: Smooth Motion
source_help: Native RTX 40/50 requires Encore 1.4.5+. Use a supported driver and the actual graphics API, then restart. The 2x counter is an estimate, not a measured displayed-frame count.

label: Smooth Motion图形接口
help: 必须与游戏实际使用的图形接口一致。
source_help: d3d12, d3d11 or vulkan: select the game's active graphics API. Restart the game to apply.

label: RTX 20 平滑运动版本
help: 仅 RTX 20 的实验功能，要求驱动 621.01及 DX12。默认 V1；更改后重启游戏，其他显卡不受影响。

label: DLSS渲染比例
help: 修改此项会调整DLSS渲染比例；不确定时保留上游默认。
source_help: Force the DLSS render resolution: game, dlaa, quality, balanced, performance, ultra-performance or custom. The game must use DLSS already.

label: DLSS自定义比例
help: 仅DLSS自定义比例使用，单位为百分比。
source_help: Render scale in percent (50 to 100) when dlssRenderScale is custom.

label: 重建后锐化
help: 默认关闭；跟随游戏使用游戏传入的锐度，自定义使用下方强度。作用于 DLSS、DLAA、RR 与替代 XeSS，NR 开启时在其后处理。即时生效。

label: 锐化强度（%）
help: 0–100%，默认 30%；仅自定义模式使用。0 不增加锐化处理。高强度可能产生光晕、放大噪点，并与游戏后续锐化叠加。

label: Reflex渲染帧率上限
help: 0跟随游戏；限制实际渲染帧，不是插帧后的显示帧。
source_help: 0 restores the game's Reflex settings; 1-1000 requests a Reflex FPS limit. FG may count toward it depending on the game/driver. Applied on options updates or the next available Reflex sleep boundary.

label: 请求关闭垂直同步
help: 修改此项会调整请求关闭垂直同步；不确定时保留上游默认。
source_help: Request interval zero on the application's own DXGI Present. Driver overrides keep priority; TEST/nested presents are preserved.

label: 光追毛发转换
help: 仅上游已验证的游戏、毛发、驱动和DXR设备组合生效。
source_help: Prepare the compatible HairWorks ray-traced conversion when the game, shaders, driver and DXR device match a verified profile. The game's hair setting remains authoritative; restart to change.

label: 神经渲染
help: 需要兼容DLSS及NVIDIA神经渲染运行库；开启可能显著增加显存与GPU负载。
source_help: DLSS Neural Rendering on the game's DLSS SR/DLAA output (D3D11, D3D12 or Vulkan with a compatible device). Needs NVIDIA's nvngx_dlssnr.dll 310.8.0. The first launch prepares it in the background.

label: 神经渲染引擎
help: Open为高度实验引擎；切换后重启，没有引擎自动回退。
source_help: nvidia (default) or opendlss (experimental). Open runs dedicated in a Direct3D game (on its own device beside the game) and in-game in a Vulkan game (on the game's device). Restart to apply; no engine fallback.

label: 神经渲染处理次数
help: 1到4次完整处理；次数越多GPU时间和显存开销越高。
source_help: Independent temporal NR passes, 1 to 4. Cost and VRAM grow. Only a complete chain is published; unsupported chain routes preserve SR.

label: 后续处理局部色调
help: 只作用于第2次及之后处理，默认0避免重复累积。
source_help: Tone applied after pass one, 0 to 2. Default zero avoids repeated tone accumulation.

label: 神经渲染分辨率
help: 神经渲染处理尺寸独立于DLSS超分辨率的渲染比例。
source_help: Size NR runs at: render (follows the DLSS render size), output (full size), quality (67 percent of the output), balanced (58), performance (50), ultra-performance (33) or custom. Smaller is faster; DLSS keeps the fine detail.

label: 神经渲染自定义比例
help: 仅神经渲染自定义比例使用，单位为输出尺寸百分比。
source_help: Percent of the output size (33 to 100) when nrResolution is custom.

label: 效果强度
help: 修改此项会调整效果强度；不确定时保留上游默认。
source_help: Strength of the effect, 0 to 2.

label: 全局图像风格
help: 修改此项会调整全局图像风格；不确定时保留上游默认。
source_help: Image style: 0 default (the runtime decides), 1 natural, 2 cinematic. Independent of the model profile.

label: 局部色调
help: 修改此项会调整局部色调；不确定时保留上游默认。
source_help: Local tone strength, 0 to 2.

label: 局部结构
help: 修改此项会调整局部结构；不确定时保留上游默认。
source_help: Local structure strength, 0 to 2.

label: 自动角色遮罩
help: 修改此项会调整自动角色遮罩；不确定时保留上游默认。
source_help: Character mask: lets the model treat skin separately (needed for nrSkinStructure).

label: 皮肤结构
help: 修改此项会调整皮肤结构；不确定时保留上游默认。
source_help: Skin structure strength, 0 to 2. Only read with nrAutoMask.

label: HDR曝光
help: HDR输入亮度，默认1；上游未公开稳定范围，通常保留默认。
source_help: HDR games: brightness given to the model (scene-linear output only).

label: 第1次处理风格
help: 修改此项会调整第1次处理风格；不确定时保留上游默认。
source_help: inherit (default), default, natural or cinematic. Independent of the NVIDIA model profile. Invalid active styles preserve SR.

label: 第2次处理风格
help: 修改此项会调整第2次处理风格；不确定时保留上游默认。
source_help: Style for pass 2, using the global style when inherit. Stored while inactive. Later-pass tone remains nrLaterPassLocalTone.

label: 第3次处理风格
help: 修改此项会调整第3次处理风格；不确定时保留上游默认。
source_help: Style for pass 3: inherit, default, natural or cinematic. Stored while inactive; does not change active history until used.

label: 第4次处理风格
help: 修改此项会调整第4次处理风格；不确定时保留上游默认。
source_help: Style for pass 4: inherit, default, natural or cinematic. Every pass re-encodes the preceding composed colour; only the complete chain is published.

label: NVIDIA运算精度
help: 精确模式保持NVIDIA结果；快速模式针对RTX20/30，可能有画面差异。
source_help: RTX 20/30: exact (same output as NVIDIA) or fast (quicker, small image differences). Gain and image differences vary by scene. No effect on RTX 40/50. Restart the game to apply.

label: NVIDIA快速处理
help: 上游称保持输出相同的快速处理；不是本管理器性能测试结果。
source_help: Faster NR processing with the same output bit for bit. Restart the game to apply.

label: 中央优先 NR（实验）
help: 中央保持完整 NR，边缘效果较柔和以降低开销；不支持时使用普通 NR。默认关闭，效果因游戏而异。

label: 中央优先 NR 预设
help: 轻度保留更多完整画面；强度越高，边缘越柔和。自定义可调整下方四项。

label: 中央区域宽度（%）
help: 完整 NR 区域占画面宽度的比例。

label: 中央区域高度（%）
help: 完整 NR 区域占画面高度的比例。

label: 每侧过渡宽度（%）
help: 从中央向边缘过渡的宽度；0 为无过渡。

label: 边缘 NR 细节（%）
help: 越低通常越快，边缘效果也越柔和。

label: 尺寸填充优化
help: 最多缩小每轴2%来减少填充开销，可能改变画面。
source_help: Optionally reduce NR's requested dimensions by up to 2 percent per axis to avoid model padding. May change the NR image; applied live. Does not change DLSS-SR render size.

label: NR并行帧数限制
help: 实验D3D12调度限制，0不限制；开启帧生成时实际至少为2。
source_help: Experimental D3D12 NR run-ahead limit: 0 baseline, 1 or 2 outstanding NR evaluations. Waits before Reflex sleep; active FG uses at least 2 to retain producer overlap. Same NR image and model; applied live.

label: Open硬件后端
help: 需要明确选择匹配硬件的Open后端；兼容模式非常慢。
source_help: disabled (choose explicitly), rtx40 (RTX 40/50), rtx30 (RTX 30, experimental) or compat (very slow, for qualification). Independent of NVIDIA precision. Restart to apply.

label: Open执行路径
help: 共享路径仅D3D12单次处理；Vulkan始终在游戏设备内执行。
source_help: Direct3D games only, where Open runs: dedicated (default; on its own device beside the game), shared (experimental, Direct3D 12 only, one NR pass: on the game's device, on a queue of its own) or in_game (experimental: in the game's own command list). Restart to apply; no fallback between them. A Vulkan game always runs it in-game.

label: Open显存换速度
help: 仅Open/RTX30；更快但会增加显存，显存紧张时关闭。
source_help: Open on RTX 30 only: shorter NR time, same image, for more VRAM: about 160 MB at 1440p DLSS Balanced. Leave off when VRAM is nearly full. Restart to apply.

label: Open快速投影
help: 仅Open/RTX30；可能产生小幅图像差异。
source_help: Open on RTX 30 only: shorter NR time, with a slightly different image. Restart to apply.

label: Open共享加载
help: 仅Open/RTX40或50。
source_help: Open on RTX 40/50 only: shorter NR time on large sizes, same output. Restart to apply.

label: Open快速精度
help: 仅Open/RTX30；不增加显存，可能有小幅图像差异。
source_help: Open on RTX 30 only: fast precision. Shorter NR time, no extra VRAM, a slightly different image. Restart to apply.

label: Open超快速模式
help: 仅Open单次处理；可能出现运动拖影和细节延迟，增加少量显存。
source_help: Open, one NR pass: ultra-fast mode. About half the NR time, the same on every frame. The image changes: the NR layer follows the image one frame late and can lag or smear in motion; a surface just uncovered or just come on screen is given what NR had made of look-alike surfaces nearby (the two tolerances below). A few MB of VRAM. Restart to apply.

label: 超快速拖影容差
help: 越低越少拖影，但更多区域暂时等待神经渲染。
source_help: nrOpenUltraFast only: how far the previous frame may differ, where a pixel was, before what NR had made there is dropped (0 to 0.3 of the code range). Lower: fewer ghosts behind what moves, more surface left to fill. Whatever this value, what moved unlike the pixel there (a character the camera turns round) is dropped. Applied live.

label: 超快速填充容差
help: 0关闭新露出区域的邻近填充。
source_help: nrOpenUltraFast only: a surface just uncovered or just come on screen takes what NR had made of surfaces of the previous frame that look like it; this is how alike they must be (0 to 0.3). 0: no filling, such a surface shows without NR until the network reaches it. Applied live.

label: Open噪声种子
help: Open确定性噪声种子，修改会重置历史。
source_help: Open deterministic noise seed. Applied live with history reset.

label: 模型界面修正
help: 修改此项会调整模型界面修正；不确定时保留上游默认。
source_help: Model UI correction.

label: NR 模型预设
help: 310.9.16：B 为较小网络，A 为较大网络；310.8.0 仅有一个网络。Open 引擎忽略此项。
source_help: NVIDIA model profile: 0 Automatic (recommended), 1-3 numbered profiles. No documented quality/speed ranking; separate from image style.

label: 显示统计浮层
help: 修改此项会调整显示统计浮层；不确定时保留上游默认。
source_help: Show the in-game multiplier and FPS overlay.

label: 浮层位置
help: 修改此项会调整浮层位置；不确定时保留上游默认。
source_help: top-left, top-right, bottom-left or bottom-right.

label: 浮层字号
help: 修改此项会调整浮层字号；不确定时保留上游默认。
source_help: Overlay text size in pixels: 10 to 32.

label: 显示神经渲染状态
help: 修改此项会调整显示神经渲染状态；不确定时保留上游默认。
source_help: Extra line when DLSS Neural Rendering is on: its state and the size it runs at.

label: 显示帧时间
help: 修改此项会调整显示帧时间；不确定时保留上游默认。
source_help: Extra line: displayed frame time (average, 99th percentile, jitter).

label: 显示GPU信息
help: 修改此项会调整显示GPU信息；不确定时保留上游默认。
source_help: Extra line: GPU load, temperature, power and clocks (NVML).

label: 显示显存信息
help: 修改此项会调整显示显存信息；不确定时保留上游默认。
source_help: Extra line: VRAM used / total on the GPU (all processes).

label: 显示组件版本
help: 修改此项会调整显示组件版本；不确定时保留上游默认。
source_help: Extra line: DLSS (SR), DLSS-G (FG) and Streamline (SL) versions loaded by the game.

label: 显示UI重组状态
help: 修改此项会调整显示UI重组状态；不确定时保留上游默认。
source_help: Extra line: whether DLSS-G UI recomposition (UIR) is on.

label: 显示无HUD场景来源
help: 修改此项会调整显示无HUD场景来源；不确定时保留上游默认。
source_help: Extra line: where the HUD-less scene comes from (game, UI assist capture or none).

label: 显示UI透明层来源
help: 修改此项会调整显示UI透明层来源；不确定时保留上游默认。
source_help: Extra line: where the UI alpha comes from (game, UI assist injection or none).

label: 显示调试信息
help: 修改此项会调整显示调试信息；不确定时保留上游默认。
source_help: Extra line: mode, generated-frame ceiling, Dynamic pacer, last Streamline result, route.

label: 高倍率画质保护
help: 修改此项会调整高倍率画质保护；不确定时保留上游默认。
source_help: Keeps generated frames clean from 3x to 6x. Leave on. Restart the game to apply.

label: 生成帧保护
help: 减少生成帧撕裂和重影；Lite 模式下不生效。需要重启。
source_help: Anti-tearing and anti-ghosting protection of generated frames (thin geometry, moving shadows). No effect with Lite composition. Restart the game to apply.

label: 快速帧生成
help: 降低生成帧 GPU 开销，与 FG 预设独立；仅启用当前 Normal/Lite 模式可用的优化。需要重启。
source_help: Lowers the GPU cost of each generated frame, same image. Independent of the FG preset: applies to A/B Normal and C Lite using the optimizations available for each path. Restart the game to apply.

label: 帧保护策略
help: 修改此项会调整帧保护策略；不确定时保留上游默认。
source_help: Protection tuning: refined (default) or classic. Restart the game to apply.

label: 自动UI重组
help: 无人深空推荐关闭，避免生成帧重复。
source_help: Turn UI recomposition on when compatible HUD-less inputs are available without the game asking for it. False follows the game. No Man's Sky: use false to avoid generated-frame duplication. See docs/COMPATIBILITY.md.

label: D3D12界面辅助
help: 仅DirectX12；游戏未提供所需输入时尝试构造界面层。
source_help: D3D12: capture the HUD-less scene and build the UI layer when the game does not tag them.

label: 强制UI重组
help: 修改此项会调整强制UI重组；不确定时保留上游默认。
source_help: Ask DLSS-G to recompose the HUD separately even when the game does not request it.

label: GPU系列覆盖
help: 通常使用自动检测；强制选择不会让不支持的显卡获得支持。
source_help: auto, rtx40, rtx30 or rtx20. Leave on auto unless detection fails. Restart the game to apply.

label: 关闭游戏菜单检测
help: 推荐关闭；游戏菜单和载入界面维持1X有助避免设备挂起。
source_help: Keep frame generation running in menus and loading screens. Leave false: idling at 1x there avoids device-hang crashes.

label: 使用NVIDIA App模型
help: 使用NVIDIA App已下载的帧生成模型。
source_help: Load the Frame Generation models downloaded by the NVIDIA App. Restart the game to apply.

label: 平滑 X3 / X4
help: 当 X3/X4 比 X2 更不流畅时可尝试；让 Streamline 安排生成帧的间隔。Encore 1.1.2 支持 DX12/Vulkan，修改后重启游戏。默认关闭。
source_help: Smooth out X3 / X4: Streamline spaces generated frames instead of the NVIDIA driver. DX12 and Vulkan in Encore 1.1.2. Restart the game to apply.

label: 跳过运动矢量膨胀
help: 旧实验项，通常保持关闭。
source_help: Legacy experiment: declare the motion vectors as already dilated. Leave false.

label: 性能CSV日志
help: 修改此项会调整性能CSV日志；不确定时保留上游默认。
source_help: Write FPS and frame times to rtx-encore_perf.csv, plus one GPU/power diagnostic sample per second in the session log (rtx-encore-logs).

label: 神经渲染诊断
help: 修改此项会调整神经渲染诊断；不确定时保留上游默认。
source_help: DLSS Neural Rendering: log what DLSS gives each frame and what NR does (10 frames after enabling, then every 300). Applied live.

label: 神经渲染GPU计时
help: 修改此项会调整神经渲染GPU计时；不确定时保留上游默认。
source_help: Record NR GPU timestamps and source-frame waits to rtx-encore_nr.csv (NVIDIA engine), or log a [NR-Open timing] line every five seconds (Open engine on Direct3D 12, with logNr; on the shared and in-game routes, also one row per step in rtx-encore_nr_open_steps.csv). The files are in rtx-encore-logs. Optional diagnostics; applied live.

label: HUD诊断
help: 修改此项会调整HUD诊断；不确定时保留上游默认。
source_help: Trace the first three game HUD-less copies and D3D12 barrier steps. Applied live.

label: 详细运动矢量日志
help: 非常详细的调试日志，日常使用保持关闭。
source_help: Very verbose motion-vector diagnostics, for debugging only.

label: 保留日志数量
help: 保留1到100份常规会话日志及相同数量的异常日志；补丁启动时保留仍占用的文件。
source_help: Logs kept in rtx-encore-logs: 1 to 100 sessions plus the same number of exception logs. Active files are preserved. Older closed files are deleted at startup.

label: 固定2X快捷键
help: 支持Ctrl/Alt/Shift/Win组合，多个组合用逗号分隔；留空禁用此操作。
source_help: Combinations such as Ctrl+Alt+4 or Ctrl+Shift+F5; several separated by commas; empty disables the action.

label: 固定3X快捷键
help: 支持Ctrl/Alt/Shift/Win组合，多个组合用逗号分隔；留空禁用此操作。

label: 固定4X快捷键
help: 支持Ctrl/Alt/Shift/Win组合，多个组合用逗号分隔；留空禁用此操作。

label: 固定5X快捷键
help: 支持Ctrl/Alt/Shift/Win组合，多个组合用逗号分隔；留空禁用此操作。

label: 固定6X快捷键
help: 支持Ctrl/Alt/Shift/Win组合，多个组合用逗号分隔；留空禁用此操作。

label: 增加倍率快捷键
help: 支持Ctrl/Alt/Shift/Win组合，多个组合用逗号分隔；留空禁用此操作。

label: 减少倍率快捷键
help: 支持Ctrl/Alt/Shift/Win组合，多个组合用逗号分隔；留空禁用此操作。

label: 切换动态倍率快捷键
help: 支持Ctrl/Alt/Shift/Win组合，多个组合用逗号分隔；留空禁用此操作。

label: 提高目标帧率快捷键
help: 支持Ctrl/Alt/Shift/Win组合，多个组合用逗号分隔；留空禁用此操作。

label: 降低目标帧率快捷键
help: 支持Ctrl/Alt/Shift/Win组合，多个组合用逗号分隔；留空禁用此操作。

label: 跟随游戏快捷键
help: 支持Ctrl/Alt/Shift/Win组合，多个组合用逗号分隔；留空禁用此操作。

label: 显示浮层快捷键
help: 支持Ctrl/Alt/Shift/Win组合，多个组合用逗号分隔；留空禁用此操作。

label: 移动浮层快捷键
help: 支持Ctrl/Alt/Shift/Win组合，多个组合用逗号分隔；留空禁用此操作。

label: 禁用全部快捷键
help: 上游JSON兼容开关，关闭所有功能快捷键。
source_help: Legacy JSON-only switch: disable all shortcuts. Intentionally not exposed in the menu.

label: 游戏菜单按键
help: 默认Insert。游戏菜单快捷键为单个按键，不能使用Ctrl等组合。
source_help: INSERT default documented; numeric VK range 1..255 verified in beta.2 RVA 0x189659.

label: 强制 Vulkan Smooth Motion
help: 忽略游戏 NVIDIA 配置中的排除项；可能产生异常。仅 Vulkan，需要重启。
source_help: Vulkan: run Smooth Motion even where the game's NVIDIA profile excludes it. Unexpected results are possible. Restart the game to apply.

label: DLSS 超分预设
help: 选择模型不会改变分辨率。实际模型取决于 DLL、驱动和游戏；需要重启。
source_help: SR preset: game (no override), default, a-f (legacy), j, k, l or m. Applies to all quality modes; supported models depend on the DLSS DLL. Restart to apply.

label: 光线重建预设
help: 不会自动开启光线重建。驱动覆盖或模型回退可能优先生效；需要重启。
source_help: RR preset: game (no override), default, a-c (legacy), d or e. Does not enable RR. Driver/model selection may override SR/RR hints. Restart to apply.

label: DLSS 帧生成预设
help: C 自动开启 Lite，需要上游支持的 310.9.16.0；有画质取舍。B 需要游戏提供无 HUD/UI 输入；需要重启。
source_help: FG preset: game (no override), a, b or c. A/B use Normal; C automatically enables Lite (faster, with image-quality trade-offs) and needs 310.9.16.0. Fast frame generation remains independent for every preset. Qualified NVIDIA releases 310.6.0.0, 310.7.0.0, 310.7.128.0, 310.7.129.0, 310.8.0.0, 310.9.0.0, 310.9.1.0 and 310.9.16.0; unknown binaries are untouched and logged. B needs compatible HUD-less/UI inputs. Lite keeps NVIDIA's native image policy: frameProtection, protectionTuning and UI recomposition are unavailable. No driver-profile writes. Restart to apply.

label: FG Lite 诊断覆盖
help: 仅诊断使用，通常保持跟随预设。Lite 下帧保护、保护策略及 UI 重组不生效；需要重启。
source_help: Diagnostic-only JSON override; not shown as a menu setting. Leave game to follow the preset (A/B Normal, C Lite) or the game/driver. Only for diagnostics with qualified 310.9.16.0: off forces Normal, on forces Lite, taking priority over the preset. Restart to apply.

label: 图形初始化日志
help: 记录图形创建、交换链和窗口调整。诊断启动崩溃时在启动前开启，日常关闭。
source_help: Trace graphics creation, COM interface upgrades, swapchain lifetime, initial presentation and resize. Applied live; enable before launch for startup crashes.

label: 详细 Streamline 日志
help: 详细记录 Streamline 和 NGX；可能降低性能。收集后关闭并重启游戏。
source_help: Extra verbose Streamline and NGX messages. Basic messages and failure reasons are logged automatically. Restart required; disable and restart after collecting the log. May reduce performance.

label: 禁用游戏内菜单
help: Encore 1.0.0：用于排查菜单冲突（如星球大战：亡命之徒）。插帧仍可工作；Insert 无法打开菜单，需在此关闭本项并重启游戏。
source_help: Encore 1.0.0: for menu conflicts (e.g. Star Wars Outlaws). FG remains active. Insert cannot open the menu; turn this off here and restart to restore it.

label: DXGI 交换链调用日志
help: Encore 1.0.0：记录游戏对菜单交换链的调用，用于排查菜单加载后的崩溃。默认关闭；需重启，收集后关闭。
source_help: Encore 1.0.0: logs game calls to the menu swapchain to diagnose crashes after menu attachment. Off by default; restart required. Disable after collecting logs.

label: 详细崩溃转储
help: Encore 1.0.0：异常日志包含寄存器和栈，崩溃时生成 .dmp（通常数十 MB）。仅诊断时开启，收集后关闭；需重启。转储可能包含进程内存，请谨慎分享。
source_help: Encore 1.0.0: adds register/stack details and a .dmp on crashes (often tens of MB). Diagnostics only; disable afterwards and restart. Dumps may contain process memory; review before sharing.

label: 快速超分（RTX 30）
help: 仅 RTX 30、DX12、DLSS 310.9.x 的 M/L 模型有效；不适用于 RR 或 DLAA。需要重启游戏。
source_help: DLSS Neural Rendering on the game's DLSS SR/DLAA output (D3D11, D3D12 or Vulkan with a compatible device). Needs NVIDIA's nvngx_dlssnr.dll 310.8.0. The first launch prepares it in the background.

label: 切换神经渲染
help: 游戏窗口内开启或关闭 NR，用于对比画面与帧率。
source_help: Combinations such as Ctrl+Alt+4 or Ctrl+Shift+F5; several separated by commas; empty disables the action.

label: 重建引擎
help: 实验功能，需要兼容的游戏输入；默认跟随游戏，RR 保持原引擎。1.2.0 的 Vulkan 需启动前选择 XeSS；1.2.1 起可在兼容游戏中即时切换，但须启动前安装兼容 Intel 运行库。更换运行库仍需重启。

label: 帧生成引擎
help: 实验功能，需兼容的原生帧生成输入。DLSS-FG 在合格的 DX12 原生 Intel FG 游戏中替换 Intel FG：重启后仍在游戏中启用 Intel FG，使用固定倍率；Game 为 2X，动态模式不可用。原生 FSR/DLSS FG 保持原引擎。

label: XeFG 多帧可变节奏
help: 仅 XeFG。关闭可能使高于 2X 的倍率不可用。

label: XeFG 界面处理
help: 分离游戏 UI 需要受支持的输入。

label: XeFG 界面透明度格式
help: 仅在已知游戏 UI 格式时修改。

label: 超分输入 HDR
help: 覆盖 SR/DLAA 输入，不启用显示器 HDR，也不把 SDR 转为 HDR。错误设置可能损坏画面；默认跟随游戏。

label: 超分自动曝光
help: 覆盖 SR/DLAA 输入，不启用显示器 HDR，也不把 SDR 转为 HDR。错误设置可能损坏画面；默认跟随游戏。

label: NVIDIA 运行库兼容策略
help: 仅本机生效。启发式允许符合限制的其他签名 NVIDIA 运行库，不保证游戏兼容性。

help: Pre-SR 仅支持普通 DLSS SR、均匀渲染尺寸；不支持 RR、DLAA、中央优先、避开填充和抖动运动输入。不满足条件时保留原始超分画面。

help: 仅 Pre-SR；与艺术风格独立。未启用的遍仍保留设置。

help: 仅 Pre-SR；与艺术风格独立。未启用的遍仍保留设置。

label: 游戏内菜单语言
help: Encore Insert 菜单语言；不更改管理器语言。

label: XeSS Tensor Cores（实验）
help: 默认关闭。上游初步验证仅 RTX 4090、驱动 621.01、DX12 及兼容 Intel 运行库；不代表其他硬件已验证。准备不支持时保持标准 XeSS 路径。

label: XeFG Tensor Cores（实验）
help: 默认关闭，独立于 XeSS 开关。上游初步验证仅 RTX 4090、驱动 621.01、DX12 及兼容 Intel 运行库；固定 2X–6X 受初始化容量限制。执行异常需重启游戏。

label: Reflex 模式
help: 不会降低游戏请求的模式；动态插帧或 XeLL 接管延迟时暂停覆盖。Boost 不保证降低延迟。

label: 延迟报告
help: 显示游戏渲染帧的 Reflex/XeLL 报告，不是显示器端到端延迟，不统计生成帧；游戏未提供标记时不显示。
